Install ghostty-nautilus on Omarchy

Open in Ghostty for GNOME Files

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-09-15.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add ghostty-nautilus
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.4.0-1:
    pacman -Qi ghostty-nautilus

Open and use ghostty-nautilus

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql ghostty-nautilus

Frequently asked questions

How do I install ghostty-nautilus on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add ghostty-nautilus. The download is 5.4 KB and it takes 2.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is ghostty-nautilus free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall ghostty-nautilus?

Run omarchy pkg drop ghostty-nautilus. It removes the package from your system.

What does ghostty-nautilus depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: ghostty, nautilus-python. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is ghostty-nautilus in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as ghostty-nautilus (version 1.4.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. ghostty-org makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty.
